decision.reason: [ev-2d0b91a93b8e] says only "bump golang from 1.24.1 to 1.24.2", so the value-changed type and the "1.24.1"/"1.24.2" values are supported. It doesn't say whether the bumped thing is the golang builder container image (image family) or the Go toolchain version the product depends on (product-relationship). So the subject identity can't be settled from the evidence. Deciding needs the diff of PR #4618, i.e. whether it changed a Dockerfile `FROM golang:` line or the go.mod `go`/`toolchain` directive.
